name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Helpline
description: 24x7 Government of India helpline for reporting cyber fraud, online stalking, and digital harassment.

name: Women Helpline (National Commission for Women)
description: Dedicated round-the-clock helpline for women facing online abuse, stalking, or domestic harassment.

name: CHILDLINE India
description: Emergency phone service for children and adolescents in distress or experiencing cyberbullying.

name: Tele-MANAS (Mental Health Helpline)
description: 24x7 National Tele-Mental Health Programme of India providing compassionate psychological first aid and emotional support.

name: National Emergency Number
description: Unified emergency response support system for police, fire, or medical emergencies.
